chapter: New York: 52nd Street and Lester Young
title: McShann out of the Army, Ben Webster and Tiny Grimes
summary: Barry Ulanov pressed him to return to McShann but Ramey explained the union rule, then worked with Ben Webster and Tiny Grimes.

story.theme_name: The musicians' union: cards, locals, and the Black-white merger
story.community_name: The musicians' union: cards, scale and the black-white merger

blocks.x: through. Now McShann gets out of the Army. Naturally, and I've got to go six months before I can work with out of town musicians. So Barry Ulanov and several of them come over there almost threatening me, you know, said, 'Look, you got to go back with McShann. He needs you, and you need him because you cannot make it in New York.'

So I told them, I said, 'Well, look, man, I am trying to get my #802 card, and I can't play with McShann because he's an out of town musician.' So I explained to McShann. He understood. And then I got situated then, and I went on in to working with Ben Webster steady. Then I went over to Tiny Grimes, who's an evil man if there ever was one, an evil man.
